title: Card number carried in a hidden field
description: A hidden input whose value is a full card number appears in the response body. The PAN sits in the page source where extensions, caches and screenshots can read it, which puts the card in scope even though the flow only needed the last four digits.
remediation: Tokenise the card at entry and never render the PAN back into the page.
limitation: One response body, first 32,768 bytes. It matches a hidden input with a long digit value; it cannot tell whether the value behind the marker is live or whether the page needs authentication.
scopeT: A response body that carries a hidden input whose value is a full card number.
fp: A field that carries only the masked last four digits is not reported.
recordDesc: A hidden input whose value is a full card number in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The PAN sits in the page source where extensions, caches and screenshots can read it, which puts the card in scope even though the flow only needed the last four digits.
applicability: Deployments that render a hidden input whose value is a full card number into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The PAN sits in the page source where extensions, caches and screenshots can read it, which puts the card in scope even though the flow only needed the last four digits.
why: The marker exists for the build or administrator and answers a question an attacker would otherwise have to guess.
fix: Tokenise the card at entry and never render the PAN back into the page.
verifyT: Request the page again and confirm the response no longer carries a hidden input whose value is a full card number.

title: Session token in a data attribute

remediation: Keep tokens in a scoped storage the page reads through an authenticated call.
limitation: One response body, first 32,768 bytes. It matches a data attribute with a long token value; it cannot tell whether the value behind the marker is live or whether the page needs authentication.

fp: A data attribute that carries a short opaque id is not reported.
recordDesc: A data attribute that carries a bearer token in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A token in markup is readable by any script on the page and persists in caches and saved pages, so it is weaker than a token held in memory only.
applicability: Deployments that render a data attribute that carries a bearer token into a customer- or partner-facing response.
